title: Burmese–Siamese War (1584–1593)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Burmese–Siamese War (1584–1593)", at revision 1379015914, opens: "The Burmese–Siamese War (1584–1593), also known as the Nandric War, was a war fought between the Toungoo dynasty of Burma and the Ayutthaya Kingdom of Siam. This war led Ayutthaya out of Burmese vassalship. This war was notable for the duel between King Naresuan and the Burmese Crown-Prince, Mingyi Swa. This war freed Siam from further Burmese domination for 174 years until 1767 when King Hsinbyushin invaded Siam, which resulted in the fall of Ayutthaya." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1456170, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1583-1593 war between the Toungoo Dynasty of Burma and the Ayutthaya Kingdom of Siam". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
